SELECT t1.uni_id AS 'uniId', t1.msg_id AS 'msgId', t1.user_id AS 'userId', t1.notify_type AS 'notifyType', (select s.DICT_LABEL from sys_dict_data s where s.DICT_TYPE = 'sys_msg_type' and s.DICT_VALUE = t1.notify_type) AS 'notifyTypeName', t1.notify_title AS 'notifyTitle', t1.if_read AS 'ifRead', t1.order_status AS 'orderStatus', t1.address, DATE_FORMAT(t1.creator_date,'%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS 'creatorDate' FROM vm_message_send_info_t t1 WHERE t1.delete_flag = '1' AND t1.if_read = '0'
AND t1.creator_date >= STR_TO_DATE(CONCAT(#{startTime}, ' 00:00:00'),'%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s %T')
AND t1.creator_date <= STR_TO_DATE(CONCAT(#{endTime}, ' 23:59:59'),'%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s %T')
AND t1.user_id = #{userId}
AND (t1.industry_code = #{industryCode} OR t1.industry_code IS NULL)
ORDER BY t1.creator_date DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO vm_message_send_info_t ( uni_id, msg_id, user_id, notify_type, notify_title, if_read, order_status, address, creator, creator_date, delete_flag, sound_close_type, sound_duration, sound_id, industry_code, alarm_source, device_code, device_name ) VALUES ( #{uniId},#{msgId},#{creator},#{notifyType},#{notifyTitle},'0',#{orderStatus},#{address},#{creator},NOW(),'1',#{soundCloseType},#{soundDuration},#{soundId},#{industryCode}, #{alarmSource},#{deviceCode},#{deviceName} )
